name: Loungepad
author: Loungepad
description: Full-bleed art, recents in a row, the grid on the way down

settings.name: Tiles across
settings.hint: How many tiles fit in a row of the grid. Fewer are larger; the recents row shows the same number

settings.name: Always show titles
settings.hint: Every tile carries its name. Off, only the tile under the highlight does

settings.name: Grid peek
settings.hint: How much of the grid shows under the recents while the art has the screen

settings.name: Dim the art while browsing
settings.hint: The backdrop blurs and darkens once the highlight is in the grid, so the tiles stand out. Off keeps it bright

settings.name: Row slide
settings.hint: How quickly the column moves between the art and the grid. Scaled by the animation speed like everything else
